identity.name: Calatrava 5196G
identity.one_liner: The Patek Calatrava 5196G — the most-cited Asian Patek dress watch: 37mm white gold, hand-wound 215 PS, sub-dial seconds, manual-wind with a 44-hour reserve.

provenance_events.description: Patek Philippe releases the 5196G as a 37mm white-gold Calatrava with the hand-wound 215 PS calibre.

narrative.story: The 5196G is the modern Patek Calatrava — 37mm white gold, hand-wound 215 PS, sub-dial seconds. The 215 PS is one of Patek's thinnest manual movements at 2.55mm thick, with a 44-hour reserve and Geneva Seal certification.
narrative.collector_notes: The 5196G is the most-cited Asian Patek dress watch because of the 37mm case (a size that's becoming more popular as Asian collectors prefer smaller, slimmer watches).
